title: Plane-wave and Brillouin-zone convergence
status_detail: The completed direct 9-SCF plus 9-linked-NSCF matrix passed a read-only identity and observable audit and supplies provisional calculated and finite-setting numerical-verification evidence. The human accepted the sequential 653.073269903544/2612.293079614176 eV cutoff pair and shifted 8x8x8 mesh as provisional settings and selected `block_pending_diagnosis`. Retained-text and build-provenance diagnoses localized GNU Fortran's normal-termination emitter. One instrumented C48 run trapped during Open MPI PMIx/hwloc OpenCL discovery in Apple's AGX Metal driver. The OpenCL-disabled run bypassed that trap but trapped on a floating-point division inside Apple Accelerate `ZTRSM`/`ZHEGVX` during QE initial-wavefunction subspace diagonalization. An isolated OpenBLAS 0.3.33 comparator excluded Apple Accelerate but reproduced the later floating-point-division trap inside OpenBLAS below `ZHEGVX`, also before the first SCF iteration. Each invocation occurred once without retry. The separately authorized LLDB attempt failed at the local attach boundary and captured no target state. The true MPI-off/OpenBLAS comparator reproduced the identical OpenBLAS frame offsets and floating-point-division instruction, excluding MPI, PMIx, hwloc, and MPI initialization as necessary causes of the later first enabled trap. The divide-by-zero-only non-MPI/OpenBLAS run reproduced the exact OpenBLAS frame and instruction, classifying the matching first later exception as IEEE divide-by-zero; the authorized sequence stopped before invalid-only or overflow-only runs. The divide operands, underflow origin, later flag origins, and effect on ordinary non-trapping observables remain unresolved. A pending checkpoint recommends one release-like, non-trapping MPI/OpenBLAS C48 comparator against the exact retained Apple-Accelerate C48 output. The selected child and this parent remain blocked pending that protected-execution decision. The direct matrix was not a canonical ScientificWorkflowRun; the optional interaction child remains deferred, and other execution and automatic successor activation remain unauthorized.
objective: Verify the frozen production pseudopotential identity and compatibility, then analyze staged wavefunction-cutoff convergence followed by SCF Monkhorst--Pack convergence evaluated at the selected cutoff.
authorized_scope: Task kind: calculation series plus numerical verification; the current phase authorizes read-only audit and compact analysis of the completed direct matrix. Human provisional-setting disposition is accepted and block_pending_diagnosis is selected for the IEEE report; the diagnosis itself requires separate authorization.

Preflight owns controlled acquisition from only the frozen exact PseudoDojo URL, atomic publication to the portable user_opt installation without repository redistribution, exact compressed and decompressed byte and metadata verification, license/citation recording, selected pw.x identity inspection without invocation, and later QE--Wannier90 interface compatibility checks. Acquisition and static verification are complete; pw.x readability remains an execution-time check and pw2wannier90.x remains later scope.

Cutoff execution, when separately authorized, varies E_cut^psi over the finite conventional candidate sequence 30, 36, 42, 48, 54, and 60 Ry with E_cut^rho=4 E_cut^psi while holding the provisional structure, exact pseudopotential, shifted 8^3 SCF mesh, occupations, diagonalization, mixing, SCF threshold, symmetry, and one-process execution fixed.

After the cutoff stage recommends E_*, admit an SCF-mesh scan only when every mesh candidate was evaluated at exactly E_*. The retained shifted-even 6^3, 8^3, 10^3, and 12^3 scan is at 48 Ry and is therefore admissible only because the cutoff stage recommends 48 Ry; the 48 Ry/8^3 case is deterministically reused from the cutoff scan.

Retain total energy per atom, pressure or stress, SCF iteration count, final code-reported convergence estimate, wall time, observable disk use, warnings, and explicitly limited fixed-point band-edge diagnostics; retain identities, tables, residuals, rejected settings, cross-checks, and diagnostic plot data.
One bounded human acceptance may select provisional cutoff and SCF-mesh settings for later EOS work; a material EOS geometry change can require a bounded recheck.

The audited direct results may support provisional-setting and warning disposition without representational rerun. They remain noncanonical execution provenance; later scientific-harness execution owns reproducibility and direct-versus-controlled comparison rather than prerequisite authority.

The authorized read-only warning diagnoses may inspect retained stdout, time/stderr receipts, compact provenance, exact executable build metadata, compiler/runtime configuration, link metadata, termination source, and retained QE 7.5 comparison evidence; they cannot invoke or probe a scientific executable or inspect dense native artifacts.
completion_criteria: Frozen authority metadata, local availability, byte-identity verification, executable identity, runtime UPF readability, later interface compatibility, numerical convergence, and scientific validation remain separately classified. Static byte/metadata and executable identity checks pass; any later readability, identity, or compatibility discrepancy stops execution.

Each primary table changes one controlled variable, applies the revised 0.05 kbar stress criterion and the 1 meV criterion only to fixed-point energies and gaps, and retains finite-setting comparisons without claiming an infinite-basis limit or effective-mass convergence.

The accepted provisional cutoff passes its lower and upper cutoff guards; the SCF mesh is selected only from a scan at that cutoff and passes its lower and upper mesh guards. No factorial interaction calculation is part of this sequential selection gate.

The human explicitly accepts or rejects the bounded provisional settings before lattice/EOS refinement; production lattice acceptance, production SCF, path, valley, Wannier, and physical-validation work remain outside this Task.
exclusions: The completed protected-execution authorization covered exactly the committed direct-bootstrap 9-SCF and 9-NSCF execution. No retry, input revision, Wannier90 execution, four-corner follow-on, or other scientific executable is authorized; pseudopotential commit and redistribution remain prohibited.

No canonical ScientificWorkflowRun exists and none is fabricated retrospectively. The audited direct observations provide provisional calculated and finite-setting numerical-verification evidence, but do not establish deterministic scientific-harness execution, accepted production convergence, numerical-verification acceptance, scientific-validation acceptance, or a ScientificDisposition.

The selected cutoff pair and shifted mesh are provisional rather than final production convergence. The IEEE report is dispositioned as block_pending_diagnosis; completed diagnoses have not resolved the later IEEE class, source operands, underflow origin, or observable impact, and no lattice constant is selected.

No production lattice/EOS acceptance, production SCF execution, symmetry-path bands, valley effective masses, Wannierization, plotting implementation, production scientific Python, physical validation, or uncertainty quantification is owned here.
Successful execution, agreement with the finest retained setting, or a diagnostic plot does not establish scientific validation or agreement with the infinite-basis limit.
